description: Look up which bank an IBAN belongs to. Returns the registered bank name, BIC/SWIFT code and address where it is published, plus whether the IBAN is structurally valid, the country and its SEPA status. Where no bank is returned the result says why: a bank code that was never issued reads differently from one we hold no record for, and neither is ever guessed at. This is the tool to use for a payment instruction. Costs one bank lookup from the caller's monthly allowance, whatever the batch size.

ibans.description: The IBANs to look up, as written. Spaces and lower case are fine. Up to 50 per call.

name: analyze_iban
title: Resolve an IBAN to its bank
